anchoredLines.line: Something pads into the clearing — The Understudy. It's here.
🗺️ Scouts found its lair — tile 7,4. THE HERALD — the sky, getting bigger. It is WAITING. You cannot face it alone. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE HERALD fed in the night — 310 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold REFUSES. they do not trust this coalition with their people. (trust −8 — refusals are remembered.)
— Stonebridge answers! Nadia Rhee and Fatima Weiss and Deshawn Ortiz and Wren Diallo and Ibrahim Weber will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! Priya Garcia and Victor Larsen and Hana Osei and Grace Petrov and Sofia Marsh will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Ashford answers! Kenji Baker and Deshawn Vega and Felix Kowalski and Lucia Weiss and Alba Adeyemi and Sofia Silva will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
⚔ THE HERALD! You're on your own.
🌅 THE HERALD FALLS. The realm exhales. That was the herald. The sky is still getting bigger.
